name: IKEA BEKVAM step stool, 50 cm (two-step)

sources.what: product page (article 401.788.88; W 43 x D 39 x H 50 cm, max load 100 kg)
assembly instructions for the rubberwood edition (not read; listed for reference)
community SketchUp model (visual, license per 3D Warehouse terms)

overallDimsMm.note: x=width (seat length, along the rails), y=depth (along the side frames, step side to back), z=height; from the product page

parts.name: side frame
parts.material: solid wood (beech/birch/rubberwood by edition), white edition lacquered
parts.dimsMm: ~390 wide at the floor x ~500 high, legs ~30x40 section
parts.notes: Each side frame arrives as a pre-joined A-shape: two splayed legs plus a cross piece; the front leg is shorter (carries the step). Shape from the instructions; section sizes estimated.

parts.name: rail
parts.notes: Span between the side frames. Two lower rails (one carries a warning label and supports the step), two upper rails under the seat. Upper rails have a vertical through-hole for the seat bolts. Length estimated from 430 overall width minus frame thickness.

parts.name: step
parts.notes: Board with a notch at each end; 2 dowels in its end grain locate it in the side frames. Size estimated.

parts.name: seat
parts.notes: Top board with a hand-hold slot; bolted from below through the upper rails. Width from product page, depth/thickness estimated.

hardware.size: connector screw with large flat hex-socket head, coarse wood thread (IKEA 100044407 / 100086), approx 6x60 mm (estimated)
hardware.notes: Joins rails to side frames end-on: 2 in step 1, 2 in step 2, 4 in step 5. Instructions show the head must sit flush.

hardware.size: machine screw with flat hex-socket head (IKEA 105111), approx M6x40 (estimated)
hardware.notes: Fixes the seat from below through the upper rails (step 6); seat presumably has pre-fitted threaded inserts (not stated).
Pushed into the step's two ends (step 3).
Plastic T-handle the key slots into; tool, included.

joins.notes: Each of the 4 rails is screwed end-on into both side frames with one connector screw per end.
Step slides onto the lower rail; its end dowels engage holes in each side frame, captured when the second frame is screwed on (no screws through the step).
3 machine screws up through the upper rails into the seat underside.

assembly.stepsSource: official instructions AA-323406-9, numbered steps 1-7 on pages 3-7 (page 2 = parts list and tool panel)
order: 1: two lower rails into the first side frame (2 connector screws), with orientation check of the labelled rail
2: two upper rails into the same frame (2 connector screws)
4: slide the step onto the lower rails
5: second side frame onto all four rails (4 connector screws), capturing the step
6: turn over, bolt the seat on from below (3 machine screws)
7: stand upright, press down to check it sits level on all four feet

referenceCad.format: SketchUp (visual mesh, not engineering CAD; not opened)

confidence: high for overall dims (430x390x500), max load 100 kg, hardware classes and counts (8x 100044407/100086, 3x 105111, 2x 101350 dowels, key 100092 + holder 121030) and the 7-step order - all read from the IKEA page and the instructions' parts list and step drawings. low for every component dimension and screw thread size (estimated from drawings and overall dims).
notes: Good small test of a frame: 2 pre-joined side frames + 4 rails + 2 boards, 13 hardware pieces, one captured (dowel-only) part. Side frames splay outward toward the floor.
